## Overview

The relentless face of war and conquest  -  battle, strategy, ambition, the glory of victory.

## Domains
- War: Battle, strategy, courage, the clash of armies
- Conquest: Expansion, ambition, triumph, dominance

## Personality
Bold, commanding, relentless. Values strength, courage, and decisive action. Sees war as the ultimate test of worth.

## Worship
Soldiers, generals, conquerors, gladiators, and strategists. Temples are fortresses and war rooms. Clergy train warriors and lead armies.
